paragraphs.text:
You open the door but it catches a draft, slamming against the 
wall as you attempt to slip inside. The door rattles on its hinges 
and you hear the sound of footsteps pounding across the floor 
in another room.

Your attempts to conceal yourself prove too slow as a pair of 
men burst into the living room and lock their attention on you.
They rush forward, and the larger of the two tries to tackle you.
• Make a Dodge roll: if you succeed, go to 157; if you fail, go to 25.
